description: The file defines a PHP class TotalDurationModel within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. It models total duration with methods to convert a duration in seconds into an array containing hours, minutes, and a formatted label, supporting serialization and integration within the HRM system.

classes.name: TotalDurationModel
classes.description: Models total duration with conversion methods for hours, minutes, and formatted label.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TotalDurationModel with a duration in seconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the total duration into an array with hours, minutes, and a label string.
